description: PAID ($0.005). Not for registries without RDAP, e.g. .za/.co.za, .me, .de, .io, .eu: refused free (422). Use when you need to know which registrar holds a domain, how old it is, and whether it is a risky newly-registered domain. $0.005. From the registry's RDAP: registrar name and IANA ID (no registrant or contact data), created, expires, last changed, status flags, DNSSEC delegation, nameservers; fail under 30 days old or expired, warn under 180 days, expiring within 30 days or on hold. A registry without RDAP is refused free. MCP: pass api_key (an Afriref key, card credit at https://afriref.dev/pricing); per-call x402/MPP payment is HTTP only, so without a key the result is an api_key_required error naming the HTTP endpoint.

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

domain.description: Domain or hostname, e.g. example.com (no URL, no IP)
